messages.title: 🚀 Release 2.4 is live (example data)
messages.text:
Hi team,

the release went out this morning. **Nothing to do** on your side.

## What changed

- faster search, *about twice as quick*
- export to CSV
- ~~legacy importer~~ removed

1. Update the desktop app
2. Sign in again

> Rollback stays possible until Friday.

Run `app --version` to check, full notes: [changelog](https://example.com/changelog)

```
app --version
2.4.0
```
